About the HOSA Bowl event

HOSA Bowl is a Teamwork event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: testing.

Ten in-depth lessons for the four-member HOSA Bowl team event, following the 2026–27 test plan (HOSA-related knowledge, parliamentary procedure, anatomy and physiology, medical terminology and current health topics at 12% each, plus 40% across history of medicine, healthcare systems, health careers, legal and ethical practices, nutrition, safety, infection control and math conversions) and the buzzer-round rules. Includes buzzer-format drills, motion and voting tables, body-system facts, word-part builders, history timelines, conversion practice and match-day strategy.

Sample HOSA Bowl questions

1. Which type of facility provides comfort care to people who are terminally ill?

  1. Hospice
  2. Urgent care center
  3. Rehabilitation hospital
  4. Ambulatory surgery center
Show answer

A. Hospice

Hospice focuses on comfort and quality of life rather than cure.

2. Why is antibiotic resistance a growing public health concern?

  1. Antibiotics now cure viral infections
  2. Bacteria evolve to survive the drugs
  3. Bacteria no longer cause disease
  4. Antibiotics have become cheaper
Show answer

B. Bacteria evolve to survive the drugs

Overuse and misuse of antibiotics speed resistance. Completing prescribed courses and avoiding unnecessary antibiotics help.

3. Who elects HOSA’s Executive Council?

  1. HOSA Headquarters staff
  2. All members online
  3. State Advisors only
  4. Voting delegates at ILC
Show answer

D. Voting delegates at ILC

Delegates evaluate candidates’ resumes, videos and interviews before electing officers for one-year terms.
